caption: A clean, warm Chinese pop ballad with piano, soft strings and a gentle beat. A clear intimate female vocal sings softly in the verse and opens up in the chorus. Mellow, emotional, hopeful, radio-friendly production.
lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse]
深海里的鲸鱼游过我的窗
把一天的疲惫轻轻放在一旁

[Chorus]
如果世界太吵 就听我唱
把没说完的话 都唱成光
